Tidy a Multiple-Factor CFA Fit

Source: R/fa_confirmatory.R
tidy.dmar_fa_confirmatory.Rd

Returns the parameter rows of a fa_confirmatory table (loadings, error variances, intercepts, latent correlations, and the defined measurement properties) in the column convention used by the broom ecosystem. Fit-information rows belong in glance.dmar_fa_confirmatory.

Usage

# S3 method for class 'dmar_fa_confirmatory'
tidy(x, ...)

Arguments

x

A dmar_fa_confirmatory object returned by fa_confirmatory.

...

Unused.

Value

A data.frame with columns term, estimate, se, statistic, p_value, ci_lower, ci_upper, conf_level, the level of the parameter intervals, and wald_df, the degrees of freedom of the t reference of the row's interval and p-value (wald_df in fa_confirmatory), Inf for the normal reference. Under wald_df = "missing_information" only the loadings and the omega rows take a t reference, so the column tells them from the other rows, as it tells the rows of one fit from another's after tables are stacked.

Author

Ken Kelley kkelley@nd.edu

Examples

data(holzinger_swineford)
res <- fa_confirmatory(holzinger_swineford,
             list(verbal = c("t6_paragraph_comprehension",
                             "t7_sentence", "t9_word_meaning"),
                  deduction = c("t20_deduction",
                                "t22_problem_reasoning",
                                "t23_series_completion")))
generics::tidy(res)
